ssm-incidents.GetReplicationSet.doc: Retrieve your Incident Manager replication set.

arn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the replication set.

createdBy.doc: Details about who created the replication set.

createdTime.doc: When the replication set was created.

deletionProtected.doc: Determines if the replication set deletion protection is enabled or not. If deletion protection is enabled, you can't delete the last Amazon Web Services Region in the replication set.

lastModifiedBy.doc: Who last modified the replication set.

lastModifiedTime.doc: When the replication set was last updated.

regionMap.doc: The map between each Amazon Web Services Region in your replication set and the KMS key that's used to encrypt the data in that Region.

value.doc: Information about a Amazon Web Services Region in your replication set.

sseKmsKeyId.doc: The ID of the KMS key used to encrypt the data in this Amazon Web Services Region.

status.doc: The status of the Amazon Web Services Region in the replication set.

statusMessage.doc: Information displayed about the status of the Amazon Web Services Region.

statusUpdateDateTime.doc: The timestamp for when Incident Manager updated the status of the Amazon Web Services Region.

status.doc: The status of the replication set. If the replication set is still pending, you can't use Incident Manager functionality.

ssm-incidents.ListReplicationSets.doc: Lists details about the replication set configured in your account.

nextToken.doc: The pagination token to use when requesting the next set of items. If there are no additional items to return, the string is null.

replicationSetArns.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the list replication set.

ssm-incidents.ListResponsePlans.doc: Lists all response plans in your account.

nextToken.doc: The pagination token to use when requesting the next set of items. If there are no additional items to return, the string is null.

item.doc: Details of the response plan that are used when creating an incident.

arn.doc: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the response plan.

displayName.doc: The human readable name of the response plan. This can include spaces.

name.doc: The name of the response plan. This can't include spaces.

ssm-incidents.ListTagsForResource.doc: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified response plan or incident.

tags.doc: A list of tags for the response plan or incident.
